summary.text: Trey Wharton is a Republican state representative from Texas who has represented District 12 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Trey Wharton earned a bachelor's degree from Texas Christian University and has worked as an insurance agency owner.
Ballotpedia lists Huntsville Independent School District, Position 7, as a prior office he held.
Wharton assumed office in the Texas House on January 14, 2025, succeeding Kyle Kacal, a Republican.
Democrat Andie Ho is also on the 2026 general election ballot for District 12.
